item.title: Cycling to train for a marathon: what transfers and what doesn't
item.description: Riding builds the aerobic engine with less impact, but it doesn't replace running. How to use it in each phase of marathon training.

item.title: How many carbs per hour in a marathon
item.description: Race fuelling, carb loading and the pre-race meal, turned from guidelines into grams, gels and minutes for your marathon.

item.title: Strength for runners and cyclists: interference or advantage?
item.description: In trained athletes, strength work doesn't cost aerobic capacity and improves economy. What the reviews say and how to fit it into your week.
